beds.intent: orbit and open space; sparser, higher and colder than the station bed, with no minor third in the sustaining floor
standing on a planet; warmer than the station bed, with a slow 24 BPM low pulse that neither other bed has

content_note: The key, voicing, loop lengths, signal and pulse figures, and layer levels are project-original modern composition. No surviving source authenticates any music for the original Keth Shipyards, and nothing here is presented as recovered or authentic Keth audio.

layers.musical_note: open D/A drift on a distant D2 with A3-D4-A4 above and no minor third, so the floor reads as cold and unresolved rather than minor-warm
layers.role: sustained open-fifth drift; the always-present floor of the orbit bed

layers.musical_note: Dm9 (D4-F4-A4-C5-E5) with five deep independent swells
layers.role: upper-register swell layer; thin Dm9 colour an octave above the station pad

layers.musical_note: five-ping A4-D5-E5-A4-F4 figure, silent at both loop boundaries
layers.role: sparse high signal pings; the orbit bed's only foreground gesture

layers.musical_note: D natural minor floor on D1/D2 with the A2 fifth, the F3 third and strong low overtones, so the floor reads as warm ground rather than vacuum
layers.role: sustained low warmth; the always-present floor of the surface bed

layers.musical_note: Dm11 (D3-F3-A3-C4-G4) with slow shallow swells and full overtones
layers.role: wide mid-register pad; the surface bed's sustained colour

layers.musical_note: eight low strikes at 2.5 s (24 BPM) over the 20 s loop, varied in pitch and weight across A1-D2-F2-A2 so the figure spans the whole loop
layers.role: slow low pulse; the one gesture neither the station nor the orbit bed has

mix_contract.runtime_gain_note: assets deliberately retain deep headroom; the runtime bed applies further per-layer trim and the Music bus carries the authored -6 dB mix offset

musical_contract.combined_cycle_note: every bed reuses the station bed's 16 s, 12 s and 20 s slot lengths, so each bed also only repeats exactly every 240 s and the runtime can hand one slot over at a time inside one fixed three-voice budget.
musical_contract.seamlessness: sustaining layers snap every partial and LFO to an integer number of cycles per loop; the flight signal layer is silent at both boundaries; the surface pulse layer wraps every tail across the join so it is periodic by construction.
musical_contract.shared_key_note: all three beds sit in D natural minor at A4 = 440 Hz, so a cross-fade between them changes register, density and colour rather than key.
musical_contract.tempo: free in the flight bed; the surface pulse layer strikes every 2.5 s (24 BPM)

runtime_intent: seamless non-positional music beds for the orbit/open-space and planetary surface states, cross-faded against the station-rest bed
